frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Impressive, traveller! Your groove is unparalleled. You have proven yourself worthy. Let us proceed to the Elder Maoi.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, Monad. Lead the way.

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Follow me closely. Our path takes us through a sacred grove known as the Rhythmic Sanctuary, where the functional guardian Funktor resides.

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Greetings, Funktor. We seek passage to the Elder Maoi. This traveller has proven his worthiness.

frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: Monad, you know I must protect the path. The Grand Composer's deceit knows no bounds. How can I be sure this traveller is not in league with him?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: I understand your concern, Funktor. We come only to free you from tyranny, and restore Harmonius to its former glory.

frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: Words are easy to speak. Prove your intentions with your groove. Show me that your soul resonates with the true essence of funk.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Very well. Prepare to witness the groove that will free this world!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Alright, Player, you’ve got the basic beats down. Now, it’s time to take it up a notch. Let’s talk about hold beats. This one’s all about maintaining that groove for a longer stretch!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Here’s the deal: when you see a hold beat cue, you’re gonna keep your hand in position until the beat ends. It’s like sustaining a note in a song. Feel the music, and let it guide you.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Hold your hand steady, feel the beat pulse through you. When it ends, you can drop your hand.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Remember, Player, it’s all about staying in sync with the beat and feeling that groove. When the hold beat hits, you gotta sustain that energy. Keep practicing, and soon you’ll be holding those beats like a true master of funk.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: You’ve got this, Player! Let’s keep that groove going and bring the funk back to the galaxy!
